payload.summary: Search says degraded but no UI renders it
payload.detail: Since PR #2805/#2808 a universal-search group carries `degraded: true` when the domain was served from the in-bundle catalogue because the canonical read could not be completed (`src/lib/universal-search.ts`, `src/lib/site-content/catalogue-seed-fallback.ts`). `live-domain-monitor` asserts on it, but no component consumes it, so a clinician cannot tell that the list they are searching may lag behind what was published. Bounded by the 30 s cooldown and by every result linking to a detail page that reads canonically, so this is a clarity gap rather than a safety one. Wants a quiet inline notice on the results surface, not a modal. Context: docs/audit/2026-09-16-registry-search-outage.md.
